instruction: Reconstruct the COMPLETE observed FloorPlan209 room using the prepared RGB references and existing reviewed shell. Codex handles ALL construction and review; no Qwen code generation. Preserve correct existing shell and cameras. Cover doors/windows, seating, rug/table, cabinet/side tables, fireplace/mirror/TV, lamps/plants and visible small props. Prefer 6-8 coherent task groups with actual physical/read-write dependencies; keep independent groups parallel. Give builders explicit approximate numeric bounds and coordinate conventions from the supplied RGB/reference evidence; label uncertainty. Scene is Z-up; box locations are centers, dimensions full XYZ extents. Floor-standing objects must contact the existing floor. Keep each complete object one semantic root, grouping its untagged mesh children beneath it. Use the actual supplied native object-focus views for local review; do not invent extra per-object view requirements or unverifiable exact pixel coordinates. All delivered evidence must still be reviewed, and the independent final gate reviews the full scene. Do not create synthetic review-only or non-geometric material semantic objects. Model actual visible lamp/downlight housings as semantic geometry; lights may be descendants of those housings. Keep global lighting changes exclusive. Use concise code and actionable reviews without relaxing fidelity. No final-review construction task: the scheduler owns final review.
